_meta.description: Extract the song spec (TITLE / STYLE / LYRICS) from the current chat AFTER ensuring the turn has completed. Reads the assistant's formatted reply; the calling workflow parses the three fields.

notes.completion-guard: s1 waits for data-is-streaming='false' so we never read a half-streamed reply.
notes.parsing: song_spec is the raw reply text. Parse with: TITLE -> /TITLE:\s*(.+)/i, STYLE -> /STYLE:\s*(.+)/i, LYRICS -> everything after the first 'LYRICS:'. Verified to parse cleanly from the structured reply.
notes.scope: Reads the FIRST .standard-markdown (correct for a one-shot song conversation). For multi-turn chats, target the last assistant message instead.
